description: Global Hubs publishes a ranked table of 50 container seaports to support comparisons of freight nodes. The maritime folder provides the same port records as CSV and Parquet, with UN/LOCODE, country, WGS84 coordinates, container throughput in TEU, annual change and an operator or authority where known. The producer is Dmitry Golubnichiy; the collection is intended as an open freight-hub inventory. The Zenodo concept DOI identifies a versioned public release, and the repository and Zenodo metadata state CC0, so the table is free. A transport modeller could locate high-throughput seaports for port-network capacity or disruption scenarios. The ranking is a top-50 selection, not a full port census. Vessel calls and cargo tonnage are absent, and this review did not inspect data rows or reconcile source years. Spatial resolution is one port and the publication is a 2026 release; individual measurement years need checking. Related Global Hubs datasets cover cargo airports, inland terminals and freight operators. A further caveat is that the documentation does not provide one shared measurement year for all ports.
